node: Optical interconnect and compound-semiconductor epitaxy tool chain: lasers, photonics, InP/GaAs epitaxy, and MOCVD/deposition tools
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around the AI optical-interconnect upstream bottleneck. The cleanest underfollowed chokepoint candidate is Veeco, because it sells MOCVD, ion-beam deposition, and wet-processing tools directly into InP laser manufacturing, with a disclosed $250M+ order tied to 800G/1.6T transceiver manufacturers. AXT is a substrate-level candidate with direct InP/GaAs wafer exposure but higher geopolitical/export-control and small-supplier risk. Applied Optoelectronics is less upstream than the node focus but is unusually relevant because it discloses in-house MBE/MOCVD laser fabrication and new 1.6T hyperscale orders. Coherent is included as a reference anchor for vertically integrated InP lasers, photodiodes, modulators, and transceivers rather than as the main underfollowed target.
